reviews.text: I highly recommend it. My dog ​​was in a family environment and will be if necessary.

Until I found the Yorki Hotel, I never trusted Pannika with anyone! I trust Évi with the utmost confidence, Panni adores her! The circumstances, the environment, and last but not least, the expertise provide the peace of mind where I am happy to leave her for the time when unfortunately I cannot take her with me. I recommend her to everyone with all my heart. Évi is a Fairy!!!

A service that is missing in today's world! The incredibly kind staff takes great care of our pets, with full board, in a great environment! We were here for the second time (now for 5 nights), still ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐🔝😊 …

The atmosphere of the dog boarding house was convincing from the first moment, everything is orderly and calm. I recommend it with full confidence to everyone who wants to know their pet is in good hands

Never again.

We were on a trial day at the Yorkie puppy boarding facility, and that one day was enough to make my dog ​​seriously ill.

I dropped off my 15-pound Westie mix there early in the afternoon and picked him up the next morning. From the minute I brought him in, he was clearly suffering: he was whining, couldn’t find a place to sit, was bloated, farted constantly, and his stomach was visibly sore. He had to be taken out almost constantly, and he had an extreme amount of stool. As an owner, it was terrifying to watch.

The dog had access to a disproportionate amount of food at the boarding facility, estimated to be at least 8-10 ounces, but he could have eaten more than that, while he normally eats 1-1/2 ounces twice a day. This is a serious, unnecessary overload for a dog of his size.

Separately, I have repeatedly indicated in advance that no food should be left in front of the dog, because it will eat everything. Éva expressly accepted and undertook this. Despite this, they clearly did not pay attention.

For me, this is gross irresponsibility. A trial day should not end with a vet visit and a suffering dog.

Based on what happened, I definitely do not recommend this boarding house to responsible, attentive owners. My dog's health is not an experiment.

Csupi, our 18-year-old Yorkshire Terrier, spent two weeks at the guesthouse, and I simply cannot find enough kind words to describe the care he received. The owner, Évike, is a true kind-hearted soul who treats every dog ​​with infinite patience, love and professionalism. It is clear that for her this is not a job, but a calling.
They paid attention to every little detail and took care of Csupi as if she were their own. I wholeheartedly ❤️ recommend this guesthouse to everyone – it is rare to find such a high level of care these days. Thank you!🙏
Our dog Szaffi always comes home from the guesthouse in a very happy mood. I can only write good things, kind, loving hospitality awaits the little ones 🥰 We highly recommend it! …
We come back here every year. My dog, who has special dietary needs and is fed strictly twice a day, is pampered. I can only write good things about the guesthouse.

I can only write good things. My old, 13-year-old, spoiled dog was in a boarding house for the first time in his life, for 8 days straight, and everything was in great order. I received him back in a very good mood, he didn't show any stress. He spent 4 days there again this week. When I arrived with him, Éva welcomed him with love, took him in, and my dog ​​didn't hesitate to want to come back to me. This is a great relief for an owner, knowing he is in a good place, safe, and loved. So I recommend it to everyone with a calm heart.
Great place! Perfect, caring care for smaller dogs! 🤗 …
We have been regulars for 14 years, they take great care of the dogs, it's obvious that they love animals and their profession is their passion. I can only recommend them!

We have been returning guests for several years with my dog ​​Leo, we really like the hotel, I am always happy to have my dog ​​back, but the last 2 times the staff was quite rude. When we arrived, there were two people standing at the gate in front of me, so we didn't ring the bell, everything was open. We waited until the previous dog was brought out, we waited in the garden, Évi the owner saw us in the meantime, he said he would be right there, while she went down another lady I don't know who it was, she asked me how we got in and what we were thinking, we always have to call. I said I was aware of it but we had already talked to Évi... Today I brought my dog ​​home, it was also a nice welcome, I rang the bell, the other lady was sweeping in the garden and returned the greeting by growling at me, did I call? I said yes I called, oh well, because that's the only way to get in here. By the way, I always bring my dog ​​during opening hours, we follow the rules, he gets along well with other dogs in principle, we have been coming here for years, so I don't understand this behavior.. that's why people don't pay two forints for it and we obviously don't take them there for fun, we just want the best if it happens that he can't come with us, unfortunately the last few times have been a disappointment... Regards: Leó's owner
I can only recommend it to Yorkies. The pricing is fair and the dog is completely comfortable and safe.

Our dog has been here several times. The last time he turned into the street he knew where I had brought him and I could see that he was excited but not afraid of the place. It gives me peace of mind that I leave him in a place where he likes to be. I always get him back healthy, well-groomed and happy. It is also very positive for me that he is here with similar small dogs, as he is afraid of larger dogs.
I consider it a reliable, excellent dog boarding house. The best one we have ever been to with any of our dogs.
I've known them for a very long time, they are reliable, very kind, and the owner (Éva Szabó) is also a veterinary assistant, so I can leave my two puppies with them with maximum safety🥰 …
A little oasis for puppies! I can only recommend it to everyone. We have been coming here with Pamacc for many years and we are very satisfied. Thank you Éva!

I can only recommend her! Éva is a fantastic person, she immediately took us and the dog in in an emergency, lovingly cared for and looked after him. She noticed and alleviated his musculoskeletal problem, got him a dog groomer, and provided us (inexperienced foster owners) with good advice. We entrusted the dog to her with a calm heart, her every move, word, and deed speaks of her love for dogs. I wish there were more people like her in the world!
